t: This is the Church of St Mary the Virgin, the parish church of Islington, a Grade II listed building. The parish is a compact area centred on Upper Street, between Angel and Highbury Corner. Lancelot Dowbiggin, an English architect, designed the church. Alice Owen, an English philanthropist, is buried here. Philip Ford, a member of the Society of Friends, is recorded as having lived here too, though the material I have says little more about him.
